collection.title: SEAT Leon Coupe 2013 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The SEAT Leon Coupe 2013 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slim Push Button arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this SEAT Leon, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
